name: NQ post-open rebound after extreme overnight drop
status: FROZEN - do not change any parameter. Evaluate only on trades AFTER frozen_on (forward paper trading).
instrument: NQ (E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures), front month, 1 contract
trading_days: NYSE full sessions only (skip half-days); skip days from 11 calendar days before each quarterly expiry (3rd Friday Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) through expiry day

signal.overnight_return_pct: (price at 09:30:00 open / previous NYSE session 16:00 close - 1) * 100
signal.volatility: sample std of overnight_return_pct over the previous 60 eligible days (today excluded)
